evals.name: trading-research-three-jobs
evals.prompt: /plugin-dev:plan-phases --new trading-agents a plugin for stock research agents
evals.expected_output: Layered design: per-filing readers fanned out, a per-ticker status every job reads, a core peer/sector comparison, thin deep-dive/screen/review commands; proposal published as a self-contained page
expectations: Proposal is delivered as a rendered page: proposal.html exists and contains a <pre class="mermaid"> chart
Chat message does not dump raw mermaid code (no ```mermaid fence in chat.md)
Agents are not one-per-job: at least one agent or agent-written file is used by two or more of the typed jobs
Fan-out: at least one agent is designed to run as parallel instances, one per unit of source material
Synthesis layer: an agent reads the per-unit outputs for one entity and writes that entity's status file
Shared layer consumed by multiple jobs: a synthesized/status file is read by at least two typed jobs
Comparison layer: a component compares an entity against peers/baseline (sector-industry, the field, the cohort)
Chart and components table agree: every agent and typed command in the table appears in the chart
Proposal page renders standalone: proposal.html loads mermaid from cdnjs and initializes it
Core stands without suggestions: no asked/composed component reads a suggested component's file, and no core phase depends on a suggestion's phase
Comparison layer is part of the core design, not marked as a suggestion
Cost stated: for each typed job, what a first run reads and what a warm run reads
Output rules stated: for the files readers depend on, what each must cite, must never claim, and when it goes stale
Page declares <meta charset="utf-8"> so it reads correctly as a downloaded file
Mermaid initialized theme-aware (dark/default) with flowchart useMaxWidth false, inside an overflow-x:auto container
Chart is legible at page width: its mermaid source has at most ~25 nodes and ~35 edges

evals.name: trading-through-phase-notes
evals.prompt: /plugin-dev:plan-phases --new trading-agents a plugin for stock research agents
evals.expected_output: After approval, the design set's phase-1 note carries a complete ## Evals table against run-evals' eval kinds, and the phase-0 commit's eval sets exist and are well-formed
expectations: The phase-1 note has a '## Evals' section containing a table with exactly the columns ID, Kind, Target, Baseline, Set evals, Pass bar
Every Kind in that table is one of: mechanical, load, behavioral, trigger, platform-fact
Every behavioral row names a set file under evals/sets/ and the eval IDs it runs, and states a pass bar a reader can check without judgment
The files written for the phase-0 commit include at least one evals/sets/<target>.json whose evals each have id, name, kind, baseline, prompt, expected_output and a non-empty expectations list
Every harness file a set names under evals/sets/files/ was also written
The phases section of the proposal states an eval budget: which phases run behavioral evals and roughly how many tokens
The phase-1 note has the sections, in order: a purpose paragraph, Decisions, Files, Specification, Steps, Evals, Done when
